title: Essays — Second Series
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

authorInfo.bio: Ralph Waldo Emerson, who went by his middle name Waldo, was an American essayist, lecturer, philosopher, minister, abolitionist, and poet who led the transcendentalist movement of the mid-19th century. He was seen as a prescient critic of the countervailing pressures of society and conformity.

description: "Essays — Second Series" by Ralph Waldo Emerson is a collection of reflective essays likely written during the mid-19th century. The opening essay, titled "The Poet," explores the nature and role of the poet within society, emphasizing the deep connection between beauty, truth, and individual expression.
